stories.title: OpenAI reportedly launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
stories.hook: Two new OpenAI models arrive at once—but what can each one actually do?
stories.angle: A scraped item says OpenAI announced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on November 17, but provides no model specifications or performance evidence. The claimed release could matter to developers and creators choosing models, so verify the announcement and compare the models before treating the names or capabilities as confirmed.
stories.money_angle: If the release is verified, test both models on a real paid workflow and compare quality, speed, and cost before switching tools.

stories.title: Genspark's VoicePad puts hands-free AI on your desk
